name: 本机真实 SSH/systemd 验收节点卸载及强制移除
command_note: Requires a disposable host with systemd and sshd that this case may own: it deletes a node through the real UI while reading back the unit and the port. Pass --root (an owned directory), --base, --ssh-port, --ssh-unit and --browser-path for that host; there is no default that can run on a developer machine.
fixture: 独立真实 server、SQLite、OpenSSH；本机真实 agent，driver=none；标准 agent unit 必须尚不存在；不使用管理 API/SSH/systemd mock

covered: 真实 SSH 故障后的重试

crud.create: 真实 API 接入为前置准备
